artworks.title: The Storm
artworks.description: Rubens' tempest — the kind of sea that drowned Ceyx while Alcyone waited on the shore of Trachis, soon to join him as a halcyon.

artworks.title: Ceyx and Alcyone
artworks.description: Wilson's calm after grief — the lovers reunited as seabirds on the halcyon days when Aeolus holds the winds.
